usedFor: Shopify holds the online store and Loyverse the point of sale, linked by “Create Or Update Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Or Update Category” in Loyverse
bestTemplate.why: Categories keep the register organised, so a new online product gets its category created or refreshed.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so customers reach Loyverse after a scheduled check, not as the shopper leaves.
